{{Top|leg}}
'''Everlilies''' were [[Flower/Legends|flowers]]. They went well in a bouquet composed of [[rojo]]s, [[Blueblossom/Legends|blueblossoms]] and [[purple passion]]s. This arrangement was reasonably expensive, and had a cost equivalent to several days pay of an [[Imperial Navy/Legends|Imperial Naval]] officer's salary.

[[Teela Kaarz]] received such a bouquet while being courted by [[Villian Dance]] on the first [[DS-1 Orbital Battle Station/Legends|Death Star]].
